name: A real look at the theme
content:
Considered details, ready to use

Neutral surfaces, a focused blue accent, and locally bundled Inter give ordinary WordPress content a consistent shape.

name: Blocks and Customizer features
content:
Familiar WordPress, with a shared design system

Build your content in the block editor and set the site’s defaults in the Customizer.

Blocks that belong together
Shared colors, typography, spacing, buttons, tables, quotes, and disclosure styles keep the editor close to the published page.
Site controls in the Customizer
Set your accent, reading and site widths, reading font, archive layout, optional sidebar, post metadata, header action, and footer text.
A useful set of starting layouts
Four editable patterns cover a business introduction, services, a contact action, and FAQs. Full-width and canvas page templates make room for different layouts.
Publishing details, already considered
Post cards and lists, featured images, archives, search, pagination, native comments, menus, and widgets work with the normal WordPress flow.
Light and dark, with the same roles
Choose a default mode or follow the device. Visitors can save their own color preference from the header.
Built to keep working
Visible focus states, keyboard-friendly navigation, mobile disclosures, and child-theme support give you a practical foundation to extend.

name: Install and activate free updates
content:
A short path from download to your site

Your free checkout includes the theme download and a lifetime update key for unlimited websites.

  1. Complete the free checkout and download the theme ZIP from your account.
  2. In WordPress, open Appearance → Themes → Add New → Upload Theme, then install and activate it.
  3. Open Appearance → Kumo Hybrid License and activate your free key to receive updates.
  4. Use the block editor for content and Appearance → Customize → Kumo design for site defaults.

The key enables updates only. All theme features remain available without it. Automatic installation follows your WordPress auto-update setting.

name: Frequently asked questions
content:
A few useful answers

What to know before you install.

Is the theme really free?

Yes. The checkout price is zero, and the included lifetime update key supports unlimited websites. There is no recurring payment for this product.

What does “hybrid” mean here?

Pages and posts use the block editor. The Customizer handles site defaults, and PHP templates provide the header, footer, and normal WordPress template flow.

Do I need a companion plugin?

No companion plugin is required. The theme uses core WordPress blocks and includes its own styles, patterns, fonts, and small navigation controls.

Does the key lock any theme features?

No. The theme works fully without a key. Activating the free key turns on updates from GauravTiwari.org. License checks send the key or activation hash, theme version, and website address to the update service.

Can I keep my existing page content?

Normal WordPress content stays in place. Theme patterns are editable blocks. Updates refresh the theme files; they do not rewrite patterns you have already inserted into a page.
